serverName.desc: Shown in the in-game server list.

queryPort.desc: The only port the server uses (UDP). Must be unique per server, e.g. 15637, 15638, ...

gameSettingsPreset.desc: With Custom, edit gameSettings in enshrouded_server.json. It is left untouched on start.

adminPassword.desc: Kick/ban, open inventories, edit world and base. Leave empty for no password.

friendPassword.desc: Open inventories, edit world and base. No kick/ban. Leave empty for no password.

guestPassword.desc: Join only, no changes. Leave empty for no password.

visitorPassword.desc: Join only, no changes. Leave empty for no password.

commands: sh -c "WINEPREFIX=/pufferpanel/.wine WINEARCH=win64 WINEDLLOVERRIDES='mscoree=d;mshtml=d' HOME=/pufferpanel wine64 wineboot --init"

groups.description: Settings for your Enshrouded server instance.
Leave empty for no password. All active passwords must differ.
